## Capability

Write up what the pass measured, in the order it measured it.

## Outputs

### pass_report

What the pass found, as one short report.

## Protocol

### 1. Report

- Fold `{scanned_entries}`, `{entry_weights}` and `{weight_delta}` into one report, naming each figure and the step that produced it.
- Name what the scan skipped. A report that omits the skipped set reads as a complete census of the directory.
- Record the report as `{pass_report}`.
